name: myocardin related transcription factor A
pathways: positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: MRTFA encodes myocardin-related transcription factor A. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity and actin binding. It participates in positive regulation of miRNA transcription and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.
